mainEight.scope: Federal Reserve calendar and FOMC statement
mainEight.finding: Official factual event calendar and 10–2 hold report cited by direct URLs; no Board logos, copied tables, graphics or agency endorsement evidenced in frozen article.
mainEight.remediation: Keep text-and-links only; preserve source credits and no endorsement; re-review any new Board content/marks/framing.
mainEight.trigger: Any quote beyond short attributed factual context, copied expression, Board mark, embed, syndication or new source.

mainEight.finding: Original GDP/PCE fact summaries, release dates, annualized vs year-over-year units and issuer links; no copied third-party BEA media.
mainEight.remediation: Preserve credit and measurement units; check restrictions for any new BEA chart/table/image/asset.
mainEight.trigger: Copying/embedding agency or third-party material; any new vendor feed or republication.

mainEight.finding: Original quarterly seasonally-adjusted 0.8% and annual not-seasonally-adjusted 3.4% summary; prior browser-backed BLS archive retrieval recorded; no BLS emblem/photography included.
mainEight.remediation: Retain citation, period/unit labels and original-only wording; recheck archived URL with real browser if link behavior changes.
mainEight.trigger: BLS emblem, photographs, copied release table, asset reuse or source revision.

mainEight.finding: Romanian Law 8/1996 Art.9(f) excludes simple facts/data; USAGov explicitly warns U.S.-government public-domain status may differ abroad. No exact copied third-party asset identified; no qualified international opinion recorded.
mainEight.remediation: Document page-specific owner decision against five links and any actual contract restrictions. Remain facts-and-links only. If substantive protected expression, marks, contractual limitation or mandatory external assessment exists, stop/escalate instead of treating internal risk acceptance as a waiver.
mainEight.trigger: New jurisdiction, media/mark, third-party chart, vendor licensing, translation, extraction or evidence of restriction.

mainEight.scope: Educational macro content and financial recommendation perimeter
mainEight.finding: Five historic issuer facts and original conditional economic interpretation verified; no trading signal, realized market-price return, original Score or explicit/implicit strategy identified. ESMA distinguishes purely factual information from MAR investment recommendations if it does not propose a strategy.
mainEight.remediation: Maintain clear fact-vs-inference distinction; review final rewritten compliance wording and any surrounding call to action or affiliate disclosure. Obtain fresh exact-copy editorial PASS. Any new buy/sell/hold, asset target, implied strategy or market return requires a different compliance/market-rights review.
mainEight.trigger: Personalization, trade idea, price target, portfolio allocation, signals, marketing/affiliate calls or scope changes.

mainEight.scope: Production analytics, consent, withdrawal and third-party data processing
mainEight.finding: Real UI and owner Network/Cookies PASS reported; code conditionally loads GA4 and telemetry and uses ga-disable plus cookie deletion attempt on withdrawal. No independently archived before/after HAR/cookie-name proof or qualified EU privacy assessment; Google-specific consent-update-denied on withdrawal not explicitly present in this code.
mainEight.remediation: Do not request redundant UI QA without new issue; preserve owner PASS, review client behavior as a defense-in-depth task, independently validate pre-opt-in, reject, accept and withdraw network/cookie names (no secrets), check controller/provider terms/transfer mechanism as applicable; if actual defect, separate scoped privacy patch with tests and approval.
mainEight.trigger: Any evidence of pre-consent beacon, withdrawal collection, failed preference, misleading notice, provider/config change or new data recipient.

mainEight.scope: Operator disclosure, government non-endorsement, editorial provenance
mainEight.finding: BaseLayout footer and Terms identify KELA LEADS S.R.L. and educational nature. Final public release artifact not built/reviewed. The actual owner reviewed content, but substantive human editorial-review evidence and explicit responsible publisher determination for EU AI Act Article 50 are not yet complete in this risk register.
mainEight.remediation: Review exact final rendered operator name/contact/Terms/Privacy, attribution and no endorsement. Record AI involvement and substantive human control + responsible publisher, or if necessary visible AI-generated-text disclosure. Check site navigation/footer/mobile and accessibility without modifying historic approved Draft.
mainEight.trigger: Public-interest AI-generated text, new editor, lack of substantive review, missing attribution, copied official seals or new legal page.

mainEight.scope: Publication version, static routing, metadata, indexing, runtime parity and rollback
mainEight.finding: Draft route rightly emits zero pages and historical component still has explicit release-false/noindex/Draft labels. Source-only copy preflight is not a compiled or browser-reviewed final artifact. Private QA Node 26 vs public production Node 24 at historical review.
mainEight.remediation: After review decisions, create separate minimal release PR off current protected main; new exact date whitelist and accurate publication metadata/date; preserve original source; inspect 200/404, seven sections, official links and original Score HOLD; run exact CI and target runtime-parity authenticated QA; obtain new final rendered owner PASS; separately authorize route/merge/Production and indexing; verify public first timestamp and rollback.
mainEight.trigger: Any attempted merge, preview, live route, sitemap, navigation, search indexing, PDF/RSS/email or production promotion.

crossCutting.scope: EU AI Act Article 50(4) on public-interest economic/financial AI-generated content
crossCutting.finding: Applied from Aug 2 2026; an exception may apply when genuine substantive human editorial review/control and a legal/natural publisher responsible for text are demonstrable.
crossCutting.requiredEvidence: Confirm whether AI materially generated/manipulated final article; record substantive corrections/source checks, accountable publisher and editor, and review exact final text. If legal exception not substantiated, assess clear Article 50 disclosure. Do not infer exception from a bare PASS.

crossCutting.finding: Google ga-disable is documented; absence of explicit denied consent update is a possible hardening improvement not proven leak. The online privacy notice acknowledges Google and cookies but no independent DPA/transfers review is evidenced in this PR.
crossCutting.requiredEvidence: Test after withdrawing consent, consider explicit consent denied update and cookie/telemetry invariants, verify versioned notice, provider processing agreement and transfer basis as applicable. Do not claim breach without direct observations.

crossCutting.scope: Final document provenance and runtime parity
crossCutting.finding: Fact/HTML editor PASS pertains to frozen Draft; publication copy and attributes require new review, and isolated preview had different Node major than public production.
crossCutting.requiredEvidence: New exact-source reviewed release artifact, automated route/source/rights negative tests, public-project target/runtime parity and authorized rollback. Actual first publication UTC only after verified public response.

crossCutting.scope: Provisional owner review and future upgrade
crossCutting.finding: Owner explicitly selected temporary internal Option B for one English article; it is not a legal waiver or independent lawyer approval. Weekly conditional upgrade watch is active.
crossCutting.requiredEvidence: Complete eight item-specific owner outcomes with residual risks, stop if actual legal prohibition, record exact decision and use Issue #1030 for cost-effective outside reviewer upgrade. All release decisions remain separately explicit.

notes: Prior owner visual and browser functional PASS are respected and not automatically repeated.
Source reuse for ordinary facts/links is lower risk: do not manufacture unnecessary license requirements.
A missing signed opinion or missing HAR is not proof of an unlawful practice; classify as evidence gap unless defect demonstrated.
All future decisions should check the canonical policy, issue #1031, owner risk record and current exact commit. Never silently transfer article-specific Option B to another project.
